text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yup, looking good~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
How was that, Big Brother?
Did Curren's feelings... reach you?
choice_data_list: I've certainly been put in my place.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
How was that, Big Sister?
Did Curren's feelings... reach you?
choice_data_list: I've certainly been put in my place.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, good of you to be so honest♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Alright! With this, next is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen... Guess that means I'll be going up against Biko-chan.
choice_data_list: How was the reception to the 'Kawaii Derby♪'?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
That is, of course—

text_block_list.name: High Schooler on the Way Home A
text_block_list.text:
I mean, have you heard of 'Kawaii Derby♪'?
That project hosted by Curren.

text_block_list.name: High Schooler on the Way Home B
text_block_list.text:
I know, right! It's totally sick.
This year's trend is basically locked in.
Major good vibes! Curren is the GOAT.

text_block_list.name: High Schooler on the Way Home A
text_block_list.text: My dad's really into the Arima Kinen or whatever... But I'll tell him to watch Curren's race too. Actually, I'll *make* him watch it.

text_block_list.name: High Schooler on the Way Home B
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen, huh?
I'll watch it with my mom. Curren's seriously trending right now."

I did notice search trends spiking on the day of the announcement...
It really does seem to be becoming the talk of the town.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Both the page views and shares for the campaign
are hitting incredible numbers!♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: This is gonna be even more exciting than the training arc we did before...♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The preparations couldn't have gone any better.
All that's left is—
choice_data_list: All that's left is to win.
All that's left is to win, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still,
there's one thing that's been bothering me—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"It's Curren Chan♪
Time for a cute little dance♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...So yeah, Curren's doing UmaTok
by going all-in on cute, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
By keeping at it steadily, I ended up getting a hundred times
more 'Good Job!'s than when I first started.
choice_data_list: Look at how popular you are.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true, but...
I still can't beat Biko-chan's usual number of 'Uma-likes'.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
To beat Biko-chan, who's been popular since day one of the service,
it looks like I'll need to come up with another clever trick.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Who do you think Curren is?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There's not much time left until the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
Maybe Curren should get totally serious♪

Our primary goal, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
and the first round of the Kawaii Derby♪ have finally arrived...
A battle with pride on the line begins!
